target_profile.system_boundary: The github.com/hashicorp/raft library, including its protocol orchestration and available repository adapters. Client FSM implementation is outside the boundary; library callback scheduling remains inside. External storage backends mentioned in README are outside the supplied implementation materials, but built-in adapters are not externalized.
protocol_contexts: Log entries carry index, term and type.
Candidate processing supports optional pre-voting and a leadership-transfer path that bypasses pre-voting.
Commitment tracking uses server IDs, the current voter map and a leader-term start index.
Protocol-version-dependent membership encoding and snapshot metadata versions coexist.
external_interfaces: Apply, ApplyLog, Barrier and VerifyLeader return futures.
FSM, optional BatchingFSM and ConfigurationStore callbacks supply application effects.
Transport supplies RPC channels, request methods, optional heartbeat fast-pass and optional WithPreVote.
Log storage supplies StoreLogs, index lookup and DeleteRange.
Snapshot storage supplies List, Open, Create and sinks with Persist/Close/Cancel interactions.
ownership: runCandidate processes protocol messages, election results and client channels in the main protocol loop.
commitment serializes voter progress and commit-index changes with a mutex.
runFSM owns its local lastIndex and lastTerm and application callback closures.
takeSnapshot requests FSM capture and main-thread configuration state through separate futures.
FileSnapshotSink implements file finalization, publication and retention cleanup; callers and sink concurrency rules remain partially unread.
selection_injection: runFSM detects BatchingFSM and ConfigurationStore with type assertions on r.fsm.
Transport permits implementations to ignore SetHeartbeatHandler and deliver heartbeats through Consumer.
The concrete FileSnapshotSink is present and inspected in part; its activation is unknown.
Catalogue entries identify in-memory, discard, network and cache implementation candidates; their behavior and constructor wiring require source acquisition.
The constructor and caller-selected storage, transport and FSM wiring are unread.
variants: Pre-vote enabled, disabled or bypassed for leadership transfer.
Optional ConfigurationStore handling in the single-entry path.
Protocol version below 2 uses deprecated peer encoding in appendConfigurationEntry; other versions use LogConfiguration.
Startup restoration may skip the FSM restore callback under NoSnapshotRestoreOnStart.
Snapshot metadata version zero reconstructs configuration from encoded peers.
File snapshot synchronization depends on noSync and operating system.
TrailingLogs controls ordinary compaction; removeOldLogs requests zero trailing entries.
unknowns: Exact module revision and active runtime configuration are not supplied.
Constructor ownership, startup ordering and selected adapter implementations are unread.
Transport result correlation, stable-term persistence and follower append handling are unread.
Storage failure atomicity, snapshot discoverability and crash durability are not established by successful interface returns.
Package compilation capability does not establish protocol behavior; precise scheduling capability is unavailable.

activities.purpose: Dispatch operations and calculate decision progress.
activities.realization_summary: Leader dispatch assigns index and term, invokes StoreLogs and reports local progress. commitment calculates a voter order statistic subject to a start-index threshold. Remote progress producers and the leader's commit consumer remain unread.
unknowns: Follower acknowledgement meaning and leader commit processing are unresolved.

activities.realization_summary: runCandidate tallies pre-votes and votes, invokes election helpers, requests follower transitions on newer terms and leader transition after enough grants. Setter and election-helper implementations remain unread.
unknowns: Vote persistence, result-channel provenance, lease handling and leadership-transfer completion are unresolved.

activities.realization_summary: Startup restoration iterates listed snapshots, accepts a restored or explicitly skipped candidate and updates protocol metadata. Runtime FSM restoration opens a snapshot and updates local FSM progress after the restore helper succeeds.
unknowns: InstallSnapshot handling, incremental catch-up and post-restore log reconciliation remain unread.

activities.realization_summary: appendConfigurationEntry derives a configuration, dispatches its log and then updates latest configuration, commitment membership and replication setup. commitment preserves progress for retained voter IDs.
unknowns: Admission serialization, nextConfiguration checks, committed-configuration transitions and replication-worker replacement remain unread.

activities.purpose: Schedule decisions into client FSM effects and correlate callback responses.
activities.realization_summary: runFSM contains single and batch application closures with different filtering and progress-update behavior. Concrete application semantics belong to the injected client FSM.
unknowns: The complete channel dispatch loop and processLogs producer are unread; queue receipt is not treated as proof of commitment.

activities.purpose: Maintain log and snapshot representations used by recovery.
activities.realization_summary: Observed code stores dispatched logs, captures FSM state, persists snapshots, closes file sinks and deletes bounded log ranges. File publication and cleanup have multiple partial-completion branches.
unknowns: Snapshot metadata writing, listing, opening, reaping and other built-in store implementations are unread.
